hypotheses.reasoning: redis-cache came back after a node replacement with 0 keys (#157). After that the cache miss ratio jumped to 97% (#158, #163), so every request fell through to catalog-db. That stampede saturated the database (490/500 connections, 99% CPU, #162), and simple primary-key queries slowed to 4-8s (#164) and timed out in search-api (#171, #202). Those timeouts show up as the web-bff 504s.
The catalog-db connection pool and CPU are maxed out, but only because of the cache-miss load.

verdict.recommendedAction: Warm the redis cache, or restore it from a snapshot. Add request coalescing or a single-flight guard and rate-limit database fallback loads, then shed load on catalog-db until the cache hit ratio is back to normal. Turn on RDB/AOF persistence so a node replacement doesn't start the cache empty.
